text: ‘Only rich countries benefit from globalisation.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Globalisation has made crime harder to police.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘The media does not have a direct impact on human behaviour.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Media content reflects the interests of the rich and powerful.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religion serves to maintain the existing social order.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘The growth of religious fundamentalism is a reaction to globalisation.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
